scholarships.title: ACIAR Pacific Agriculture Scholarship Support (PASS) Program - Fiji National University 2027 intake
scholarships.official_source: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR), PASS Program administered at Fiji National University

eligibility: Pacific Island Country National from an ACIAR partner country: Fiji, Kiribati, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Tonga, Tuvalu or Vanuatu
35 years or below when applying for Master's programs, 45 years or below for PhD, with flexibilities considered in exceptional cases
Master of Science in Agriculture or Forestry (thesis component): Bachelor's degree in the relevant field with a GPA of 3.0 or above
Masters by Research: Postgraduate diploma GPA 3.00 or above, or Bachelor's degree GPA 3.5, or Honours Bachelor's degree GPA 3.00, or a Master by coursework, or recognised professional experience
PhD: Master by Research degree, or a coursework Master's with GPA 4.0 plus a research methods course, or an Honours Bachelor's degree with GPA 4.0 or above, or recognised professional experience
Sufficient English fluency, evidenced from undergraduate or other English qualifications
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to nationals of ACIAR partner Pacific Island countries: Fiji, Kiribati, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Tonga, Tuvalu and Vanuatu. Applicants must be 35 or under when applying for Master's programs and 45 or under for PhD, with flexibilities considered in exceptional cases, and must meet the academic prerequisites for their chosen FNU program.
benefits: Full tuition coverage for the relevant program of study
Living allowance of FJD 21,450 per annum unaccompanied or FJD 32,472 per annum accompanied
Book allowance of FJD 750 as a one-off payment
Establishment allowance of FJD 1,900 as a one-off payment if applicable
Medical insurance at the prevailing rate
Research grant of up to FJD 17,500 for Master's students and FJD 40,000 for PhD students

requirements: Check eligibility with the ACIAR Graduate Officer before applying
Complete the application and research intent in consultation with prospective FNU supervisors and the corresponding ACIAR project leader or co-supervisor
Select a research project from the PASS Compendium of Research Topics
Upload all documents as a single PDF attachment
documents: Research intent using the PASS Research Intent Form 2027 template, signed by the FNU supervisor and relevant co-supervisor
application_method: Identify a project from the PASS Compendium of Research Topics
Contact the corresponding FNU supervisor and co-supervisor to agree the topic
Develop the research proposal and research intent with the supervisors
Email a single PDF attachment to aciar-go@fnu.ac.fj with the subject line 'ACIAR Scholarships 2027'
existing.selection_notes: ACIAR's Pacific postgraduate scholarships are offered in the Pacific, to Pacific Islanders, so that scholars research agricultural problems in the context where the solutions need to work. The PASS Program aims to strengthen the Pacific agricultural innovation system by building on the strengths of Pacific universities and their regional partners, and sits within ACIAR's Pacific Capacity Building Strategy.
existing.best_fit: Pacific Island nationals in agriculture, forestry or fisheries who hold a degree in a related field and want research training at Fiji National University without leaving the Pacific.
existing.notes:
ACIAR is an Australian Government statutory authority within the Australian Government's Foreign Affairs portfolio, and the ACIAR PASS administration team is based at FNU. No bond or service obligation is stated on the official page. The medium of instruction at FNU is English.
Funding period: per annum (unaccompanied living allowance rate; FJD 32,472 per annum if accompanied)
existing.duration: 24 months for Master's students, 36 months for a PhD candidate
existing.application_period: 2027 intake, Graduate Term 1 2027. Applications opened Thursday 20 August 2026 and close at 5pm FJT on Wednesday 21 October 2026.
